actions.action: Move plant to brightest spot, ideally south- or west-facing window
Alternatively set up LED grow light 6-12 inches above for 12-14 hours a day
Increase light gradually to avoid sunburn
Check soil and water only when fully dry
Cut off top rosette, let callus 2-3 days, set on dry cactus mix
Mist rosette lightly after roots form
Cut stretched stem into sections to propagate

reason: The answer correctly identifies etiolation and its main advice (more light plus beheading and propagating) matches the fix that worked, with nothing harmful.
